name: env_tools
description: Which toolchains/binaries the machine has (git, python3, go, node, docker, gcc...) with versions; no network

tools.description: binary names to check instead of the built-in list of 18 (git, python3, go, node, npm, docker, podman, gcc, make, cargo, rustc, java, ruby, php, ssh, rg, jq, curl)

limit.description: max present tools to version-probe and return (default 50)
